top.title: 'Unified' team beats Easton police and fire in charity game
top.description: A packed Oliver Ames High School gym cheered the Unified Basketball Team to a 48-34 victory over local police and firefighters Oct. 28 in Easton. About 300 people attended the season finale, according to a community announcement, turning the game into a celebration of the school's Unified Sports program and the student-athletes who participate in it. Oliver Ames Unified Basketball brings students with and without intellectual disabilities together on the same 24-member team, coached by Kristin Marani, who also heads the school's English Department. "This game was a blast, and the atmosphere was amazing, just as we hoped," Marani said. "We had a ton of fun. Being part of this team and being able to connect with our kids has been the absolute joy of my whole career. Thank you to everyone for the awesome turnout. And thank you especially to the Easton Police and Fire departments for taking part." Students packed the supporter section known as the "Tiger Pit," remaining on their feet and joining the Oliver Ames High School Cheerleading Team in chants. Handmade signs with messages supporting the student-athletes covered the gym walls. Players exchanged high-fives and encouragement throughout the 40-minute game as Marani cheered them from the sideline. Unified Basketball program expands at Oliver Ames The game capped the Unified Basketball Team's third season. The team played eight games this season, double the four games it played last season. Before basketball was added, Oliver Ames established its Unified Sports program with Unified Track. Unified Bocce is scheduled to join the program this winter. Marani also recognized the team's six seniors for their leadership. "I'm really proud to have those six kids," Marani said. "They've been absolutely unbelievable leaders." Before the game, team members honored Easton Public Schools employees who supported them during high school. The employees received gift bags and joined the players for a group photo. Players completing their final season also received bouquets of flowers. The game raised money for the Oliver Ames Unified Sports program. Supporters bought 120 yellow "One Team" T-shirts before the event, and raffles were held during the game. Easton police and firefighters join students on court Craig Davidson, director of special services for Easton Public Schools, refereed the game. "When we have events like this or Unified teams, it really brings so many different people together and builds a strong bond within our school community and our community at large," Davidson said. "Thank you to our Easton Police and Fire departments. They have always, no pun intended, responded to our calls for support with fundraisers and events on campus.” Deputy Police Chief Phil Adams said the event gives first responders an opportunity to connect with the community while having fun with the student-athletes. top.title: Ebonyi govt lifts suspension on Ambertone as Ishiagu Community buries slain youths
top.description: By Chiamaka Ekwuwe The Ebonyi State Government has lifted the temporary suspension on mining operations at the Ambertone Logistics Limited facility, operated by Zotmann Mining Limited, in Ihetutu community, Ishiagu, Ivo Local Government Area, following consultations with relevant stakeholders and the burial of two youths who died in a shooting incident in the area. The resumption of operations on Wednesday followed days of engagements involving the state government, representatives of the mining company, bereaved families and community stakeholders aimed at restoring peace and normalcy. The development comes after the deaths of Chibuike Elema, 18, and Obinna Gideon Akandu, 20, in a shooting incident reportedly involving a military officer on Sunday, October 18, 2026. The precise circumstances surrounding the incident, including the events leading to the shooting and the responsibility of the personnel involved, remain subject to clarification by the appropriate authorities. Available accounts indicate that the incident occurred approximately three kilometres from the company’s operational facility, reportedly near another mining concession. Following the incident, tensions reportedly escalated in the community, with some youths allegedly attacking the mining company’s facility, resulting in damage to vehicles, equipment, offices and other property. In response to the developments and concerns over public safety, the Ebonyi State Government ordered a temporary suspension of mining activities at the affected facility to prevent further escalation and facilitate peace-building efforts. Following consultations and reconciliation engagements, the government subsequently announced the lifting of the suspension, allowing operations to resume. Ambertone, Zotmann Clarify Company Identity The incident also generated conflicting reports concerning the identity of the mining company operating the affected facility. While some initial reports associated the incident with Palladium Mining Company, subsequent clarification from company representatives identified Ambertone Logistics Limited as the company whose facility was affected by the unrest. Representatives further clarified that Palladium Mining Company operates a separate facility in the community and is distinct from Ambertone Logistics Limited and its operational partner, Zotmann Mining Limited. The clarification was issued to address confusion arising from reports that appeared to have linked Palladium Mining Company to the incident. Representatives of Ambertone and Zotmann also stated that neither company authorised the shooting, maintaining that the incident occurred outside their operational premises. The circumstances surrounding the shooting and any possible responsibility of individuals involved remain separate matters requiring appropriate investigation. top.title: ‘Let Me Just Be a Reporter for the Browns’ — Shilo Sanders Frustrated With Cleveland Reporters for Asking Shedeur Sanders ‘Stupid,’ ‘Set-Up’ Questions
top.description: ‘We Need More of This,’ ‘Making Up Fake Beef’ — NFL Fans React as Saints DE Puts Browns’ Shedeur Sanders on Notice After plenty of anticipation and debate, Shedeur Sanders finally gets his opportunity to start for the Cleveland Browns in the 2026 season. Deshaun Watson, who entered concussion protocol earlier in the week, managed to clear it late Saturday. However, Sanders received all the first-team reps during the week, prompting head coach Todd Monken to make a decision and name Sanders the starter for the Week 9 meeting with the New Orleans Saints. As expected, Sanders has already started facing tough questions from Browns reporters, something his brother Shilo believes are mostly “stupid” and deliberate “set-up” questions aimed at making the quarterback slip on a banana peel. Shilo Sanders Takes Issue With Browns Reporters’ Questions to Shedeur Sanders Ahead of the matchup, the Browns QB had a brief interaction with reporters. One of them asked Shedeur how it felt to be in a similar position to last year, taking over the starting role after initially being sidelined. “I definitely want to thank just the whole coaching staff and Andrew Berry and everybody part of the organization for giving me another chance, you know, to be here for this year, this season, and everything. Last year, I’ll say I was able to see what I needed to see, feel different things during the games, and understand what I need to get better at,” he said. Another reporter asked Shedeur, “How does this offensive system fit you?” “That’s just a setup question,” Shilo said while reacting to the interaction on his YouTube stream. Meanwhile, another reporter questioned Shedeur about hiring an agent, asking if that was “just a natural development.” The second-year QB shrugged off the question, saying it had nothing to do with the game. Shilo, however, took issue with the reporter’s approach and issued a blunt reaction. “Bro, everybody has an agent. This is another set-up question. Man, let me just be a reporter for the Browns because I can actually ask some good questions,” Shilo said on his stream. BE THE GM OF YOUR FAVORITE TEAM: PFN’s Free NFL Mock Draft Simulator Last season, Shedeur made seven starts for the Browns, posting a 3-4 record before returning to a backup role behind Watson at the start of this season. After eight games with Watson under center, the Browns are 5-3 and rank No. 22 in PFN’s NFL Team Impact Rankings . Apart from the team’s inconsistencies and inability to make plays in the fourth quarter, one of its biggest issues has been the pressure Watson has faced. The offense has surrendered 33 sacks through eight games. Shedeur is expected to face a similar challenge and could have very little time inside the pocket when he makes his first start under center in Week 9. The Browns’ matchup against the Saints is scheduled for 1 p.m. ET on Sunday, November 8, at the Caesars Superdome in New Orleans. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

top.title: Stephen Curry’s 41-point explosion prompts bold ‘so so back’ verdict from Bill Simmons
top.description: Photo by Ezra Shaw/Getty Images Bill Simmons has declared Stephen Curry is “so so so back” after the Golden State Warriors star produced another outstanding performance in their overtime win over the Orlando Magic. Curry scored 41 points as the Warriors claimed a 126-119 victory, extending their winning streak to seven games and improving their record to 7-3. The 38-year-old has been in terrific form during that run, following up 34 points against the Phoenix Suns and 29 against the Miami Heat with another 40-point display. Bill Simmons reacts to Stephen Curry’s latest Golden State Warriors masterclass Simmons, founder of The Ringer, could not hide his excitement after watching Curry take control against Orlando. Taking to X, he posted: “STEPH NEVER LEFT BUT REGARDLESS STEPH IS SO SO SO BACK.” There is certainly plenty of evidence behind Simmons’ verdict. Curry finished with 41 points on 13-of-19 shooting, including five three-pointers from 10 attempts, while converting all 10 of his free throws. He also added six rebounds and six assists, setting another NBA record in the process. Curry has now recorded 16 games with at least 40 points since turning 35, moving clear of LeBron James, who previously shared the record with 15. His impact was particularly clear late in regulation, when he scored 12 unanswered points in the final 2:21 to help send the game into overtime. Draymond Green has seen plenty of Curry’s best moments since they began playing together in 2012, but admitted the veteran guard continues to surprise him. Speaking to USA TODAY Sports, Green said: “It never gets old. He’s so special, like, he always does something to where it can’t get old. You know, it’s always something different.” Curry was not the only Warrior to impress, with rookie Yaxel Lendeborg contributing 23 points. Brandin Podziemski also added 15 points and seven rebounds as Golden State’s bench outscored Orlando’s second unit 42-31. The Warriors have turned their season around after losing their opening three games and will now look to make it eight consecutive victories against the New Orleans Pelicans. Given Curry’s current form, Simmons may have every reason to keep celebrating. Slipping into the danger zone Nottingham Forest’s shock 3-1 victory over Manchester City pushed the Red Devils into the bottom three. While the result marked a third consecutive league defeat for City, the collateral damage was felt most at Old Trafford. For the first time since November 1986, United find themselves occupying a relegation spot after playing at least nine matches. That grim 1986 campaign saw the club sitting 21st after 15 fixtures. The dismal run famously cost Ron Atkinson his job, paving the way for Sir Alex Ferguson’s arrival. Now, Carrick has overseen the club's worst start of the Premier League era, mirroring a crisis unseen in 40 years. top.title: Internet governance about to get its quadrennial stress test at ITU meeting
top.description: The International Telecommunications Union (ITU) kicks off its quadrennial plenipotentiary on Monday, and internet governance organizations are bracing in case the event becomes a forum for nation-states to try to challenge their roles. The ITU is the United Nations' specialized agency for information and communication technologies, meaning its members are nation-states. The body's role is to facilitate international connectivity, which it does by managing radio spectrum, satellite orbits, and working on relevant technical standards. Its key standards are pervasive. ITU-T X.509 sets out the rules of public key infrastructure. ITU-T E.164 governs telephone numbers. ITU-T H.264 and 265 define the video codecs used for most online streams. The ITU's role is largely uncontested, yet its work gets very close to that of the organizations who work on technologies that make the internet work. Those bodies include the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF); the Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN), which oversees the domain name system; and the regional internet registries (RIRs), which manage IP addresses. The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) works on HTML, CSS, and accessibility. Governments participate in work at those internet governance bodies but are just one voice among many and can't override the consensus-driven decision-making process they use, under a system which has come to be known as the multi-stakeholder governance model. At a 2025 event called WSIS+20, the United Nations endorsed multi-stakeholder governance by deciding that its Internet Governance Forum (IGF) should become a permanent body. That decision effectively endorsed multi-stakeholder governance, and kept the ITU out of internet standards. Yet the IGF hasn't met since WSIS+20, so it is yet to start operating meaningfully as a permanent body. This year's ITU meeting is therefore a moment at which stakeholders can stress-test the delicate balance between the ITU, internet governance bodies, and the emerging IGF. Such a test could see ITU members try to have it pursue new fields that overlap with work performed by internet governance organizations. This has already happened before. China tried to have the ITU work on " New IP" – a major revision to internet protocol, a technology the IETF manages. In 2022, Russia and China backed a candidate for the ITU presidency who favored giving nations a stronger role in internet governance, potentialy by having the ITU take over some standards work. That candidate was not elected. Ahead of next week's meetings, the Internet Society published a background paper that declared it is "actively challenging proposals that could affect the Internet's underlying technical architecture or increase fragmentation, as well as those that could affect connectivity, particularly for remote, underserved, and unserved communities." top.description: Arsenal FC v Hull City - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Paul Merson has heaped praise on Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard following his match-winning performance against Hull City. The former midfielder likened the Norwegian to a new signing after he secured three crucial points to extend their lead at the Premier League summit. Arsenal secure gritty Hull win Arsenal were forced to dig deep to secure a hard-fought 1-0 victory over newly promoted Hull City at the Emirates Stadium. Mikel Arteta's side looked destined to drop points before Martin Odegaard struck a decisive 72nd-minute winner. The crucial victory moved Arsenal six points clear at the top of the Premier League table. Their grip on first place was strengthened further after title rivals Manchester City suffered a shock 3-1 defeat away to Nottingham Forest . High-flying Brighton are the only side to beat Arsenal so far this season. They could cut the gap at the summit to five points if they defeat Brentford. Merson hails outstanding Arsenal captain Former Arsenal midfielder Merson was thoroughly impressed by Odegaard's match-winning contribution. Merson believes the Norwegian has been the standout performer for the north London club during the opening months of the season. "He’s been outstanding. He’s the only one really that moves it quickly," Merson told Sky Sports . "He moves it quickly, he moves, he gets into positions. I just thought too many players took too many touches and they slowed it down and gave Hull half a chance. "I think he’s been outstanding this season, he’s like a new signing for them and he’s been the man so far. Not great but just a good result for Arsenal. But again, he was one of the stars of the show." Odegaard discovers his goalscoring touch Odegaard has enjoyed a remarkable resurgence in front of goal during the 2026-27 campaign. His strike against Hull took his tally to five goals in all competitions, a massive improvement from managing six goals in 45 appearances last term. The Arsenal captain showed sharp predatory instincts to secure the victory. Konstantinos Tzolakis parried a powerful strike from Noni Madueke, but Odegaard was the quickest player to react inside the penalty area. "He’s the first one to react and there’s two defenders in front of him," Merson explained. top.title: Real Madrid midfielder highlights key to team’s success after Valencia victory
top.description: Real Madrid midfielder highlights key to team’s success after Valencia victory Real Madrid put in another convincing performance in their last game before the start of the November international break as they visited Mestalla and beat Valencia with a 3-0 scoreline . Three players who are all in very good form, Federico Valverde, Arda Guler, and Kylian Mbappe, scored the three goals for the Merengue side. Meanwhile, another player who has been gradually growing in this team and has already become a very important part of Jose Mourinho’s scheme is the midfielder Bernardo Silva, who again started this game and helped his team control the tempo from the center of the pitch. As Diario AS has reported, the Portuguese playmaker also talked to the media after the game. Silva highlighted how the physical approach from Valencia and the referee’s leniency for their fouls made this game quite difficult for his team: “It was a difficult match against an aggressive team and with a referee who allowed that aggression. That made things complicated. Fede’s fantastic goal helped us a lot. I felt that we were always in control. We were organised and managed their transitions well. We won possession back quickly, and we’re happy with the three points.” The Real Madrid midfielder was happy with his team reaching eight consecutive wins, but was clear that they will have to continue with this run of form: “It means we’re in a good position to compete. We’re very happy, but those eight consecutive wins count for nothing now. We have to keep going like this. Keep winning and winning.” Silva highlighted his team’s quality in the attack and praised Federico Valverde’s goal: “It’s simple: he strikes the ball very well and should shoot even more often. The other goals came from some great combination play involving Jude and Arda. With this team and this quality, good things will always happen.” The Portuguese veteran was also happy with his team’s defensive effort and the clean sheet: “Very important. We always know that teams who defend better are better prepared for matches and for winning titles.” The Real Madrid midfielder was looking forward to returning to play at the Santiago Bernabeu after a run of away games: “We’re always eager to return home. I’m sure the fans will be waiting for us.” There is no doubt Bernardo Silva’s presence has allowed Real Madrid to play better and this improvement is also clear from the team’s results. Hopefully, he will continue playing at this level and help the Merengues become one of the very best teams in Europe and in Spain.

top.title: Supercars Sandown: Sunday win sets up Matt Payne for title challenge
top.description: Motorsport photo Matt Payne has taken his sixth Supercars win of the season and cemented his points lead with an all-the-way – but in the end, narrow – win at Sandown Park in Melbourne. Payne put his Grove Racing Ford Mustang on pole for the second day in a row and beat Anton De Pasquale , who started alongside in the Team 18 Chevrolet Camaro, to the first corner. From there, Payne had the pace to build a gap and he did, until ‘ADP’ cleared traffic and closed over the final laps. The Camaro had the speed and started the final lap under a second behind, and with Payne facing even more traffic ahead. The gap closed, and Payne held on, to take the victory by 0.7s. As well as De Pasquale drove, second was never going to be enough for him to qualify as a finalist. Under Supercars’ Finals system, the only way he could make that move was to win the race, after Brodie Kostecki ’s Saturday win effectively meant he, Payne and only two other drivers could move forward. “That was so stressful, it couldn’t tell you,” Payne smiled after his first win since August. “I saw the train of cars, and I managed to get through some of them. We didn’t have much left at the end, but I managed to get home by the skin of my teeth We had the car speed this weekend, it was probably a little bit better than yesterday. We found ourselves a bit this weekend, we hit all our marks.” Photo by: EDGE Understandably De Pasquale was a disappointed runner-up. “I gave it everything, I was trying to hunt him down,” he said. “He got a little bit of a better one [start] and he wasn’t degging [tyre degrading] as much as I hoped he would.” Ironically, in a season in which De Pasquale has often looking like Chevrolet’s only contender, another Camaro was third. Just two weekends after he moved to the PremiAir Racing after leaving Erebus Motorsport , Cooper Murray started third and that is where he finished, after a drive that was unobtrusive because it lacked anything that looked like an error. “I am very emotional at the moment,” he grinned after the first top-three result of his career. “Second round with this team and we are on the podium. On to bigger and bigger things. “I always knew I had the belief in my own ability. Thank you to everyone at PremiAir Racing for giving me the opportunity. I got off the [start] and it was a steady race from there, probably one of the easiest races I have had in the Main Game.” Broc Feeney took fourth in his Triple Eight Ford, thereby ensuring that he is one of the four Finalists, on what was a tricky weekend for the team. Will Brown started the weekend in Finals contention but his hopes were doomed before the race started. He failed to advance from the first phase of Qualifying by 0.04s and started the race from 19th, from where only freakish circumstances would have placed him in contention to win. No such events came; by the flag he was an impressive sixth, just 12 seconds behind teammate Feeney, but it was win-or-bust for the former champion. Photo by:

top.description: FBL-ENG-PR-EVERTON-CHELSEA - AFP Chelsea head coach Xabi Alonso has challenged his squad to earn their place back among Europe’s elite following a promising start to his debut season at Stamford Bridge. While the Spaniard has utilised a lighter schedule to implement his tactical ideas, he admits he is desperate to swap quiet training weeks for the chaos of continental competition. European ambitions at Stamford Bridge Alonso has enjoyed a productive start to life in West London, but the Spaniard is already looking ahead to a future where his schedule is significantly more congested. While the current campaign has allowed for extensive tactical work at Cobham due to a lack of European commitments, the former Bayer Leverkusen boss is eager for those "long weeks" to become a thing of the past. The Blues currently sit fourth in the Premier League table, having secured 16 points from their opening nine matches. This solid domestic foundation has been built during a period where Alonso could focus purely on the training pitch, yet the manager views this absence from the continental stage as a temporary situation that must be rectified by next season at the latest. Ahead of a clash with Sunderland—a side surprisingly balancing European duties this term—Alonso made his intentions clear. "The ambition is to be back there [in Europe]," said the Blues manager on the club's official website . "[We want it] to be just one season that we are having long weeks. The aim, the desire, the hunger is to have busy weeks, to have to deal with three games a week, and that we'll see each other much more." Building a new identity at Cobham The absence of midweek fixtures has arguably been a blessing in disguise for Alonso during his transitional phase. It has provided the necessary time to forge bonds with a young squad and drill the specific positional play that defined his success in the Bundesliga. top.title: Yoruba started home video, not Nollywood — Osuofia
top.description: Veteran Nollywood actor, Nkem Owoh, popularly known as Osuofia, has clarified his position on the origins of Nigeria’s home-video industry, insisting that Yoruba filmmakers pioneered home-video productions but did not start Nollywood. Owoh made the clarification during an appearance on Curiosity Made Me Ask, hosted by comedian and content creator Adebayo Abidemi, popularly known as Bae U. The interview, published on the host’s YouTube channel on Saturday, featured the actor responding to a question about reports that he had claimed Yoruba people, rather than the Igbo, started Nollywood. The clarification comes amid an ongoing debate over the contributions of different ethnic groups to the development of Nigeria’s film industry. The debate gained fresh attention in August 2026 when late veteran actor Francis Duru argued that the Igbo built Nollywood but that Yoruba filmmakers had become more dominant because of their ability to organise and promote their productions. Duru, who died in October, had attributed much of the growth of the modern home-video industry in the 1990s and early 2000s to Igbo entrepreneurs. Reacting to the reported interpretation of his earlier comments, Owoh said it was inaccurate to suggest that he claimed Yoruba people started Nollywood, explaining that the name did not exist when filmmakers began producing movies. “First of all, you have given me this wrong accusation that I said, Yoruba started Nollywood. No. Yoruba started this film on… when did Nollywood come out? When we started the thing, there was no Nollywood as a name. “We sat together and we’re banding, you know, ideas and all that, how the thing is going to come to fruition. And eventually, we chose Nollywood,” he said. The actor, however, credited Yoruba filmmakers with popularising home-video productions in Nigeria, specifically mentioning veteran filmmaker Hubert Ogunde and Adebayo Papa as among those whose works he admired. “So, Yoruba started the thing. They made the thing very popular home video and all that. Yes, they did. And I’ve said it several. Okay. Ogunde and Adebayo Papa. These are the people I love to watch their thing,” he said. When the interviewer jokingly suggested that Ogunde was Igbo, Owoh disagreed, insisting that the late filmmaker was Yoruba. “Ogunde is not Igbo. I’m telling you that Yoruba started it. When Ogunde was out, I don’t think there was any Igbo man who was that popular in that,” he added. He further emphasised the distinction between the origins of home-video productions and Nollywood, stating: “The Yoruba did not start Nollywood. They started Home video.” Historical accounts of Nigerian cinema trace the development of Yoruba filmmaking to travelling theatre groups led by figures such as Hubert Ogunde and Duro Ladipo, whose stage productions evolved into film and video productions decades before the commercial home-video boom of the 1990s. nigeria.description: By Chiamaka Ekwuwe The Ebonyi State Government has lifted the temporary suspension on mining operations at the Ambertone Logistics Limited facility, operated by Zotmann Mining Limited, in Ihetutu community, Ishiagu, Ivo Local Government Area, following consultations with relevant stakeholders and the burial of two youths who died in a shooting incident in the area. The precise circumstances surrounding the incident, including the events leading to the shooting and the responsibility of the personnel involved, remain subject to clarification by the appropriate authorities. Available accounts indicate that the incident occurred approximately three kilometres from the company’s operational facility, reportedly near another mining concession. Following the incident, tensions reportedly escalated in the community, with some youths allegedly attacking the mining company’s facility, resulting in damage to vehicles, equipment, offices and other property. In response to the developments and concerns over public safety, the Ebonyi State Government ordered a temporary suspension of mining activities at the affected facility to prevent further escalation and facilitate peace-building efforts. Following consultations and reconciliation engagements, the government subsequently announced the lifting of the suspension, allowing operations to resume. Ambertone, Zotmann Clarify Company Identity The incident also generated conflicting reports concerning the identity of the mining company operating the affected facility. While some initial reports associated the incident with Palladium Mining Company, subsequent clarification from company representatives identified Ambertone Logistics Limited as the company whose facility was affected by the unrest. Representatives further clarified that Palladium Mining Company operates a separate facility in the community and is distinct from Ambertone Logistics Limited and its operational partner, Zotmann Mining Limited. The clarification was issued to address confusion arising from reports that appeared to have linked Palladium Mining Company to the incident. Representatives of Ambertone and Zotmann also stated that neither company authorised the shooting, maintaining that the incident occurred outside their operational premises. nigeria.title: Messi wins second consecutive MLS Golden Boot after scoring 26 goals
nigeria.description: Inter Miami’s Lionel Messi won his second consecutive MLS Golden Boot award on Saturday after the defending champions took second place in the Eastern Conference with a wasteful 3-3 draw against Charlotte on the final day of the regular season. The Argentine superstar did not score but set up the first two goals at Miami’s Nu Stadium, both from corners, to help procure his club a home-field advantage for the first two playoff rounds. Messi’s 26 goals this season were enough to make him the first back-to-back MLS Golden Boot award winner. Petar Musa of Dallas was second on 22, not scoring in his club’s 3-1 home victory over Colorado. Ian Fray, Luis Suarez and Rodrigo De Paul racked up three first-half strikes for Inter Miami before Liel Abada’s brace soon after the break sparked a comeback sealed by Rodolfo Aloko’s late strike. Runaway overall leaders Nashville broke the all-time MLS points record for a season with a whopping 77 after beating Cincinnati 2-0. At 23-3 with eight drawn, Nashville won the East and broke the mark of 74 points set by Miami in 2024. Miami finished second in the East on 60 points as third-place New England failed to take advantage of Inter’s draw with a surprise 1-0 loss at Orlando to end on 58. Messi’s men will face Columbus to begin the MLS playoffs. Other East matchups send New England against Philadelphia, Charlotte against Chicago and top seed Nashville against the wild-card winner, Orlando or Cincinnati. Columbus took advantage of the Cincinnati loss with a 4-3 victory at Chicago to finish seventh and avoid the wild card round. At Miami, Messi’s 14th-minute corner fell unexpectedly to Charlotte’s Luca de la Torre, who spooned it up for Fray to open the scoring. Another Messi corner in the 33rd minute found Suarez wide open at the near post. The Uruguayan glanced in his header for 2-0. De Paul made it three before halftime, but Abada pulled back a goal for the visitors early and bagged a second in the 55th minute. In the 90th, Aloko bagged the equalizer, responding first to the ball as Smalls’s shot ricocheted off the post. A visibly frustrated Messi hit the post in stoppage time before Aloko came inches from bagging an unlikely winner with a thunderous shot into the outside netting. – Seattle, Real advance – Western Conference champion Vancouver beat Canadian rivals Montreal 2-0 to finish second overall, giving the Whitecaps a home-field edge if they should face Inter Miami in a rematch of last year’s MLS Cup final. There were six teams fighting for the last three Western Conference playoff spots on “Decision Day” with every MLS squad on the pitch. Portland, Colorado and the Los Angeles Galaxy needed only to win to secure a playoff berth but only Portland did so, the Timbers winning 2-0 at Austin while Real Salt Lake beat the Galaxy 2-1 and Colorado fell at Dallas, which allowed Real into the post-season. Seattle claimed the other spot with a 2-1 home win over Los Angeles FC. Albert Rusnak scored in the first minute

nigeria.description: Iranian authorities have executed three men convicted of carrying out operations on behalf of Israel and the United States during anti-government protests in January, the country’s judiciary has announced. The death sentences against Hassan Divband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were carried out on Sunday after being upheld by the Supreme Court, the judiciary’s Mizan Online website reported. According to the report, the three men were found guilty of “participating in operational activities on behalf of the Israeli Zionist regime, the United States and hostile groups” during the protests. Mizan said the defendants threw Molotov cocktails and grenades, used bladed weapons and firearms, and set fire to public facilities in Karaj, a city west of Tehran. Other defendants in the case received prison sentences ranging from five to 10 years, the report added. The protest movement, which initially erupted in December over the rising cost of living, rapidly developed into widespread anti-government demonstrations that peaked on January 8 and 9. Iranian authorities reported more than 3,000 deaths during the unrest, blaming the violence on what they described as “terrorist acts” orchestrated by the United States and Israel. However, foreign-based non-governmental organisations have reported higher casualty figures and maintained that Iranian security forces fired on protesters. The number of executions in Iran has increased since the outbreak of the Middle East war, which was triggered in late February by US and Israeli strikes on the Islamic Republic. nigeria.title: U-17 WWC: How we overcame opening defeat to win title – Oluebube
nigeria.description: Nigeria’s Flamingos forward, Oluebube Umejiaku, has explained how the team recovered from their opening defeat to Poland to win the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. Nigeria began their campaign with a 2-1 loss to Poland, despite Umejiaku scoring as a substitute. However, the team bounced back, treating every subsequent fixture as a final on their way to winning the competition. The Flamingos defeated DPR Korea, Mexico and other opponents before overcoming Japan 2-1 in Saturday’s final to claim the trophy. Umejiaku, who started the tournament on the bench, became one of Nigeria’s standout performers, scoring crucial goals, including in the final, and winning the Golden Ball award as the tournament’s best player. Speaking to FIFA.com after Nigeria’s historic triumph, she said the players were determined to change their fortunes following the opening loss to Poland. “When we lost the first game against Poland, everybody said we needed to wake up because we didn’t come here to look at anybody’s face and we have to take every game as a final. We don’t downgrade anything; we play and we put all our best into every game.” Umejiaku also reflected on her journey from a substitute to one of the tournament’s most influential players, saying she remained hopeful of getting an opportunity to start. “Every time I went to training and every time I slept, I told God that I’m praying for all the people that are starting. But when I wanted to start, I just told God that it is my time,” she said. Another key contributor to Nigeria’s triumph was Awawu Bashiru, who initially had limited playing time under head coach Akeem Busari. Bashiru played just 77 minutes between the opening match and the quarter-final against Venezuela before earning her first start against Brazil. She scored twice in that encounter and also opened the scoring in the final against Japan. Reflecting on the team’s achievement, Bashiru credited their success to teamwork and the technical crew’s instructions. “I’m so happy, I’m so excited and I’m so grateful,” she said. “The teamwork, instruction and listening to our coaches is why we got the goals and why we won the final. We are history-makers. We made Nigeria, and the millions of people there, proud.” Busari, meanwhile, explained that his decisions to change the starting line-up were based on the players’ attitude, character and commitment rather than reputation. “No matter how good you are, I’m a coach that plays on character,” Busari said of making those key changes. “It’s all about mindset, attitude and merit; if they’re there, you get your playing time. If they’re not there, you’re waiting to come in. As a coach, we want everyone to wire up and play together.” Nigeria’s victory made the country the first African nation to win the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup and the first from the continent to claim a women’s FIFA tournament title. nigeria.title: Israeli president Herzog picks Eisenkot to form new government
nigeria.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has chosen opposition leader and former military chief, Gadi Eisenkot, to form a new government following an election that left both his camp and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition short of a parliamentary majority. Herzog’s office announced on Saturday night that the president had informed Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party, of his intention to give him the mandate to form a government. The formal appointment is expected to take place at a ceremony at the president’s residence in Jerusalem on Sunday. “This is the time to establish a national emergency government. I will do anything possible to prove us worthy,” Eisenkot wrote on X following the announcement. The decision brings Eisenkot closer to replacing Netanyahu, Israel’s longest-serving prime minister, after the religious-nationalist coalition lost its parliamentary majority in the October 27 election. Netanyahu’s camp secured 54 seats in the 120-member parliament, while Eisenkot’s opposition bloc won 48, leaving both short of the 61 seats required to form a government. During consultations with Herzog, Eisenkot received endorsements from two Arab-majority political lists, whose support could prove crucial in the coalition-building process. However, uncertainty remains over whether Eisenkot’s bloc would accept a formal alliance with the Arab-led parties, particularly after more than three years of war in Gaza. Netanyahu has opposed any arrangement involving the Arab parties, accusing them of supporting terrorism and warning against forming a government with what he described as “terrorist supporters”. He has also called for a national unity government. Eisenkot, however, has indicated a willingness to work with Arab-led parties under certain conditions, including their acceptance that Hamas is a terrorist organisation that must be dismantled. He has also pledged to take action against extremist Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank accused of attacking Palestinians, describing the incidents as “Jewish terror” allegedly enabled by Netanyahu’s government. Despite his willingness to engage with Arab-led parties, Eisenkot opposes the creation of a Palestinian state. He has also vowed to end Hamas’ rule in Gaza and destroy its military wing. Eisenkot served as Israel’s Chief of General Staff from 2015 to 2019 and commanded the military during the 2006 war with Hezbollah. During the conflict, he developed the so-called “Dahiya doctrine”, a military strategy advocating the use of overwhelming force against civilian infrastructure in areas controlled by Hezbollah. Under the Israeli constitutional process, Eisenkot has 28 days to secure the support of at least 61 lawmakers and form a government. Herzog can grant him an additional 14 days if he fails to meet the deadline. If Eisenkot cannot secure a parliamentary majority within the allotted period, the president may offer the mandate to another candidate. Failure by any candidate to form a government

nigeria.title: WIMBIZ pushes for more women in business, leadership through mentorship
nigeria.description: By Enitan Abdultawab The Women in Management, Business and Public Service (WIMBIZ) has renewed its push for greater participation of women in business and leadership, identifying mentorship, visibility and empowerment as key tools for helping women access opportunities and advance their careers. The Executive Head of WIMBIZ, Omowunmi Akingbohungbe, said the organisation was committed to inspiring and empowering women to attain leadership positions while equipping them to become entrepreneurs. Speaking during an interview at the organisation’s 25th annual conference in Lagos, Akingbohungbe said WIMBIZ connects experienced and accomplished women with emerging leaders to guide them through the challenges of building careers and businesses. “We’re big on mentoring. We connect mentors, accomplished and experienced women with rising leaders so they can handhold them and show them the path so they’re not reinventing the wheel,” she said. She also stressed the importance of visibility, noting that women needed to make their abilities known, develop confidence and put themselves forward for leadership opportunities. According to her, many women often hold back from applying for leadership positions because they feel they are not qualified, whereas men are more likely to take the chance. “Most times women will think I’m not qualified and all of that, but men would apply. And we also have the potential,” she said. Akingbohungbe said WIMBIZ was therefore working to ensure women recognise their capabilities and have the confidence to pursue opportunities in business and public service. “At WIMBIZ, we train, mentor, empower women. We give women a right to be entrepreneurs at the same time,” she added. She described the organisation’s partnership with Autos, its official automobile partner for the annual conference, as part of its 25th anniversary celebrations. She said the partnership would also provide discounts to WIMBIZ members and free vehicle servicing for two years. nigeria.title: FIFA U-17 WWC: Why we lost to Nigeria in final – Japan coach Shirai
nigeria.description: Japan U-17 women’s national team coach, Sadayoshi Shirai, has praised Nigeria’s Flamingos following his side’s 2-1 defeat in the final of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. Shirai admitted that Nigeria’s speed and physical strength posed major problems for his players, particularly when the Flamingos managed to break through their defence. Nigeria secured the title through goals from Oluebube Umejiaku and Awawu Bashiru, while Fuki Ito scored for Japan. Reacting after the encounter, Shirai acknowledged Nigeria’s superiority but maintained that his players gave their best throughout the final. “First of all, I have to say that Nigeria were a very strong team. We understood their strengths, but there were moments when they managed to get in behind our defence. Even so, I think our players fought incredibly hard until the very end, doing everything they could to cope with Nigeria’s speed and physical power. I also believe that if we had managed to score earlier, we might have had a better chance of winning the match. I want them [Japan’s players] to be proud of themselves. The way they fought until the very end of this World Cup will have inspired many people, and I hope they can take confidence from that,” Shirai said. Japan reached the final after defeating DPR Korea in the semi-finals, while Nigeria booked their place in the title decider with a victory over Brazil. The Flamingos eventually defeated Japan to claim the U-17 Women’s World Cup trophy, marking a historic achievement for Nigerian women’s football. nigeria.title: INEC to meet over Atiku’s 2027 ADC ticket
nigeria.description: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) says it will meet next week to consider the implications of the Federal High Court judgment nullifying the David Mark-led leadership of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), including the emergence of former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar as the party’s 2027 presidential candidate. The commission said it would not take a position on the party’s leadership crisis until it obtained and examined the Certified True Copy (CTC) of the judgment. The Federal High Court in Abuja had, on Thursday, nullified the Mark-led caretaker committee and invalidated decisions taken under its leadership, including the party’s presidential primary that produced Atiku as its candidate for the 2027 general elections. Speaking on Sunday, INEC National Commissioner and Chairman of its Information and Voter Education Committee, Mohammed Haruna, said the commission would not rely on media reports to determine the court’s position. “We can’t take a position until we see the judgment ourselves. We have to get the Certified True Copy because we don’t take decisions or reports of what the court said based on reports because the reports could be wrong,” he said. Haruna added that the commission would deliberate on the matter at its meeting next week. “Well, this one is very straightforward. Even then, we are all here till next week when the commission meets. We will have to meet over it,” he said. He also said INEC would comply with any further court order arising from an appeal by the Mark-led faction. “Obviously, if the David Mark faction should appeal, which I am sure they will, and they get an injunction for stay of execution, obviously, we’ll have to obey that judgment,” he added. The judgment followed a suit marked FHC/ABJ/CS/1819/2025, filed by a former ADC Deputy National Chairman (North-East), Nafiu Bala Gombe, who challenged the process through which Mark and other members of the caretaker committee assumed control of the party. nigeria.title: Nigerians debate how much money is enough for Detty December
nigeria.description: Nigerians have taken to social media to debate how much money is enough to enjoy Detty December, with proposed budgets ranging from ₦50,000 to ₦15 million. The discussion began after financial services company Cowrywise asked Nigerians how much they considered a reasonable budget for the festive season in a post on X. The question generated different reactions, reflecting varying expectations and spending plans for the December festivities. While some users suggested modest amounts, others indicated that enjoying the season could require millions of naira. One respondent, VictorBen, jokingly said he would rather spend ₦3 million buying a MacBook and sleeping throughout December. Detty December has become a popular expression for Nigeria’s end-of-year entertainment season, characterised by concerts, nightlife, parties, travel, social gatherings and other festive activities. The period, particularly in Lagos, attracts Nigerians in the diaspora and international visitors, while entertainment venues, hospitality businesses and event organisers often experience increased activity. nigeria.title: Two waterway accidents kill police officer, woman in Bayelsa
nigeria.description: By Samuel Oyadongha, Yenagoa Two separate waterway accidents in Bayelsa State have claimed the lives of a serving police officer and a female passenger, the state Police Command has confirmed. The incidents occurred in Brass and Sagbama Local Government Areas, according to a statement issued on Saturday night by the Police Public Relations Officer, DSP Musa Mohammed. The first accident involved a passenger boat that capsized along the Abedigbene waterways in Brass LGA on Thursday while travelling from Yenagoa to Akassa with eight persons on board, including a serving commissioner. The police said Maritime Union workers in Brass reported the incident, prompting a search-and-rescue operation by personnel of the Nigerian Navy’s Forward Operating Base (FOB) FORMOSO, in collaboration with local divers and members of the Abedigbene fishing community. Seven passengers were rescued, including the Bayelsa State Commissioner for Trade and Commerce, Dr Ebiere Jones, and an officer of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps. However, a serving police officer who was initially reported missing was subsequently confirmed dead. The second accident occurred at about 5:20 a.m. on Saturday, November 7, along the shoreline of Angalabiri Community in Sagbama LGA, when a tanker vessel belonging to Sterling Global Oil Ltd reportedly collided with canoes navigating close to the shoreline. According to the police, preliminary investigations indicated that the vessel struck and destroyed some of the canoes. One of the victims, identified as Mrs Victoria Abetnigo, an indigene of Angalabiri, sustained serious injuries and was rushed to Ebedebiri General Hospital for treatment. She was, however, pronounced dead by the attending doctor. Her remains have been deposited at Ofoni Mortuary, while investigations are ongoing to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident. Reacting to the two tragedies, the Commissioner of Police, Bayelsa State Command, CP Ajao Saka Adewale, expressed sadness over the incidents and extended his condolences to the families, colleagues and loved ones of the deceased. The police commissioner particularly lamented the death of the serving police officer, praying for the peaceful repose of the souls of the deceased and strength for their families to bear the losses. He also commended the Nigerian Navy’s FOB FORMOSO, local divers, Maritime Union workers and members of the Abedigbene fishing community for their prompt intervention during the rescue operation. Adewale urged boat operators and commercial vessel owners to exercise caution and comply strictly with maritime safety regulations. He specifically called on vessel operators to maintain safe distances from shorelines and established canoe routes and avoid reckless navigation. He also advised passengers to wear life jackets throughout their journeys and urged all waterway users to prioritise safety and promptly report emergencies to the appropriate authorities. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows The U.S. Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network issued a final order Friday that will cut offshore exchange MEXC Global off from the American banking system over alleged links to sanctions evasion by Iran, North Korea and Russia, the department said . FinCEN’s order, published as a PDF pending Federal Register placement, finds MEXC a “primary money laundering concern in connection with Russian illicit finance” under section 9714(a) of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act. Thirty days after that Register notice, covered U.S. financial institutions will be barred from any funds transfer — including convertible virtual currency — to or from MEXC. Reuters reported the same cut-off Friday afternoon. Treasury framed the move as part of Operation Economic Outcast. It is not an OFAC sanctions designation: the order says it does not rewrite Bank Secrecy Act duties or OFAC rules, and it is a FinCEN funds-transmittal ban rather than a Section 311 proposed rulemaking. Treasury alleges MEXC facilitated at least $16 billion in illicit flows from May 2021 through May 2026, including nearly $1.5 billion tied to Russian sanctions evasion and about $22 million linked to Iran’s Central Bank and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ Qods Force. The platform was still processing trades with sanctioned Garantex and successor Grinex as recently as June 2026, more than four years after OFAC designated Garantex, the release says. What the order does — and when The order , signed by FinCEN Deputy Director Jimmy L. Kirby, covers MEXC Global and named affiliates operating outside the United States, including Seychelles-incorporated MEXC Global Ltd / MX Global Ltd, Estonia’s MEXC Estonia OÜ, Switzerland’s GIDA Technology AG and the U.K.’s MXC Global Ltd, plus successors. Covered institutions face civil or criminal penalties for willful violations. Until the Federal Register publishes the notice, the 30-day clock has not started. As of Friday evening eastern time the Register’s public index still showed no MEXC document, matching the order’s own cover note that publication is pending. Background on MEXC Founded in 2018 and formerly branded MXC, MEXC ranks among the world’s 20 largest centralized crypto venues by volume. Treasury puts daily turnover above $1 billion and reserves near $5 billion as of mid-2026, with access claimed across more than 170 countries. The exchange already lists the United States as a prohibited jurisdiction in its user terms, so Friday’s action mainly hits any remaining dollar rails, banking partners and counterparties that still touch U.S. institutions. Regulators elsewhere have been circling for years. The U.K. Financial Conduct Authority put MEXC Global Ltd on its warning list in March 2024 as unauthorized. entertainment.title: From the Sky to the Earth To You: Earth & Sky by Banke Kuku
entertainment.description: With Earth & Sky , her Spring/Summer 2027 collection, Banke Kuku turns to nature’s most essential cycle: the sky gives rain, the rain feeds the earth, and the earth gives back. Reimagining the water cycle as a circle of life, the collection celebrates the abundance that flows from it. Earth & Sky is built around seven prints in three families. The Sky family is led by the hero print, Bougainvillea Sky, with watercolour bougainvillea, bees, butterflies and birds drifting across a turquoise ground, alongside Dove Sky and Daybreak Sky. The Earth family, Yellow Trumpet and Flower Bud, draws on flowering plants such as Costus spectabilis . The Rain family pairs Raindrop, a glossy, near-photographic print set against the softness of the watercolours, with the Kuku Monogram in fresh colourways. Sky prints are finished with hand-embroidered clouds and raindrops on flowing kaftans and kimono robes. Speaking on the inspiration, Creative Director Banke Kuku shares: “I never start with a sketch. I start with a feeling, and for Earth & Sky, that feeling was abundance. This year I became a mother for the first time, and everywhere I looked, nature was reflecting that same fullness back at me. This is my most personal collection.” A CYCLE OF GIVING BACK In nature, nothing is wasted, and everything returns. Earth & Sky carries that principle as its message: what we take from the earth, we must give back. That principle extends into how Banke Kuku approaches production. The brand maintains a no-waste policy, finding uses for offcuts rather than discarding them, while its seasonless approach allows pieces to remain part of the collection beyond a single season. Banke Kuku also uses digital printing, which consumes less heat and water than conventional printing methods, and continues to reduce its use of man-made fabrics in favour of more conscious material choices. Its commitment to the natural world extends beyond its collections, including its work with the Nigerian Conservation Foundation and its Re-Green Movement, which supports afforestation and the restoration of Nigeria’s natural environment. entertainment.title: Inside the Story of Martell’s Afrobeats Limited Edition XO with Davido and Prince Gyasi
entertainment.description: There’s something special about a collaboration that brings together music and visual art, particularly when both creatives have spent years helping African culture reach audiences around the world. For its latest limited edition, Maison Martell has brought together Nigerian music superstar Davido and Ghanaian visual artist Prince Gyasi to create a new expression of its prestigious XO cognac , inspired by the sound, movement and global influence of Afrobeats. The Martell Afrobeats Limited Edition XO will be unveiled in Nigeria on November 6, following the collection’s global launch in New York on October 28. At the heart of the collaboration is Prince Gyasi’s distinctive artistic language. Known for his vibrant colours and imaginative compositions, Gyasi has created an original artwork of Davido that features on the limited-edition bottle and presentation box. The design draws inspiration from the landscapes of West Africa, bringing together Martell’s iconic blue with shades of amber and gold. The blue reflects the rhythmic flow of the ocean, while the golden tones evoke sunlit sands and the warmth of African sunsets. Reimagined through Gyasi’s distinctive, hyper-surreal visual style, these elements create a composition that captures the movement and energy of Afrobeats while celebrating the unity, strength and creative spirit of the continent. For Gyasi, the inspiration goes beyond the visual appeal of the bottle. Growing up in Ghana, his experience of music and its ability to bring people together informed the creative direction of the collaboration. “Growing up in Ghana, I’ve seen firsthand how music brings people together, sparking connection, celebration, and pure joy. As Davido says, ‘We rise by lifting others,’ a reminder that music builds community and lifts us all. I feel a deep pride in Afrobeats, its incredible journey, and the mark it’s making on global music,” Prince Gyasi said. entertainment.title: Adaugo Nwankpa: What a Career Transition Taught Me About Starting Over
entertainment.description: One year and two months ago, I took a career pivot. I moved from being a digital media professional writing stories, articles and shaping narratives to becoming an analyst in the energy sector, working across the oil and gas and renewable subsectors. The journey across these two industries that are worlds apart has taught me lessons on starting over You are never really starting from scratch No matter what you are starting over at or what you are getting into, it is important to realise that you are never truly starting from zero. Where ‘zero’ means the state of having nothing: skills, experience, network, intelligence, and others. While it may indeed appear that you do not have the things you consider as being critical to starting over, you actually have what you have: the knowledge, skills and experiences that have shaped your life and marked your journey up to this present moment, and this is invaluable. Also, having a strong knowledge of yourself is also an incredible resource when starting over, as it helps you to discern and differentiate challenges that are due to your personality, and challenges that are due to the circumstance of starting over. Your ‘Next Best Move’ is hidden within your network When we think of network, it is easy to limit it to close friends, relatives or even acquaintances. This is quite a restrictive and limiting view of the concept of network. Your network also includes ‘strangers’ and your internet community. In my case, I knew of the opportunity in the energy sector through a friend whom I had met on Instagram. It gets more interesting. By the time I was preparing for my first interview, I knew that I had zero knowledge about the current state of the sector. Thanks again to Instagram, I reached out to someone I followed who I knew worked in the sector, and she offered a free virtual coffee chat. I went into the interview more confident in what value I could offer and what mattered for such a role. Transferable skills are invaluable Prior to my career pivot, my only exposure to the energy sector aside from buying fuel and gas was a seminar paper I had written in my final year investigating annual shifts in fuel pump prices. However, I audited my skills and qualifications and noted that I also had highly transferable skills. I had communication, business development and a good knowledge and expertise in using Canva. For you, it could be international exposure, multiple languages or something else you think is insignificant. No matter what you are starting over at, you have something that can be transferred from where you were to where you are or where you want to be. Adopt a growth mindset In today’s world, flexibility, adaptability and agility are your currencies for greatness. entertainment.title: Loving Itohan: Come for the Love Story, Stay for Everything Loving Itohan Says About Grief and Family
entertainment.description: Nancy Isime ‘s first film as executive producer, from GREOH Studios, is a beautifully shot story about the love that holds a family together when life falls apart. Some films you watch. Others stay with you. Loving Itohan is the second kind. It opens like the love story you think you already know: a radiant bride, an Edo wedding, coral beads and gold everywhere. You settle in for romance. Then, slowly, the film shows you its heart, and it is so much bigger than a love story. At its centre is Itohan, played by Nancy Isime, a woman whose world is shaken by loss and by truths she never saw coming. What follows is a story about grief, the quiet kind that stays in a home long after the visitors have gone. It is about family, the people who hold us up and sometimes weigh us down. And it is about love that has to keep choosing to stay, even when it hurts. You will see yourself in it. In the person trying to hold everyone together. In the things left unsaid at the dinner table. In the slow, uneven way healing actually happens. A film that looks as good as it feels The cinematography deserves its own round of applause. Every frame feels deliberate, from the rich reds and golds of Edo tradition to the close, quiet moments where a single look says everything. The camera knows when to celebrate and when to simply sit with a character in her pain. This is a film made for the big screen. There is a reason it all feels so assured. Loving Itohan is from GREOH Studios , and Jade studio has never been afraid to go big, with daring, genre-bending stories like Gangs of Lagos. This time, GREOH goes deep instead, trading spectacle for the messy, tender feelings we all carry. True to form, it also hands the director’s chair to a fresh talent, Orobosa Ikponmwen , the latest in a line of new directors the studio has backed, from Kayode Kasum to Loukman Ali. And for Nancy Isime, this is her very first project as an executive producer. You can feel how much of herself she has poured into it, in front of the camera and behind it. Alongside her, Uzor Arukwe, Martha Ehinome Orhiere, Dorathy Bachor, Grace Dein Coker, Chioma Nwosu, Florence Sunday and newcomer Obehi Aburime bring the family to life. Don’t judge it by the trailer If the trailer has you thinking you know where this is going, trust us, you don’t. Go with someone you love. Bring tissues. And maybe call your mum afterwards. Brandin Podziemski also added 15 points and seven rebounds as Golden State’s bench outscored Orlando’s second unit 42-31. The Warriors have turned their season around after losing their opening three games and will now look to make it eight consecutive victories against the New Orleans Pelicans. sports.title: Supercars Sandown: Sunday win sets up Matt Payne for title challenge
sports.description: Motorsport photo Matt Payne has taken his sixth Supercars win of the season and cemented his points lead with an all-the-way – but in the end, narrow – win at Sandown Park in Melbourne. Payne put his Grove Racing Ford Mustang on pole for the second day in a row and beat Anton De Pasquale , who started alongside in the Team 18 Chevrolet Camaro, to the first corner. From there, Payne had the pace to build a gap and he did, until ‘ADP’ cleared traffic and closed over the final laps. The Camaro had the speed and started the final lap under a second behind, and with Payne facing even more traffic ahead. The gap closed, and Payne held on, to take the victory by 0.7s. As well as De Pasquale drove, second was never going to be enough for him to qualify as a finalist. Under Supercars’ Finals system, the only way he could make that move was to win the race, after Brodie Kostecki ’s Saturday win effectively meant he, Payne and only two other drivers could move forward. “That was so stressful, it couldn’t tell you,” Payne smiled after his first win since August. “I saw the train of cars, and I managed to get through some of them. We didn’t have much left at the end, but I managed to get home by the skin of my teeth We had the car speed this weekend, it was probably a little bit better than yesterday. We found ourselves a bit this weekend, we hit all our marks.” Photo by: EDGE Understandably De Pasquale was a disappointed runner-up. “I gave it everything, I was trying to hunt him down,” he said. “He got a little bit of a better one [start] and he wasn’t degging [tyre degrading] as much as I hoped he would.” Ironically, in a season in which De Pasquale has often looking like Chevrolet’s only contender, another Camaro was third. Just two weekends after he moved to the PremiAir Racing after leaving Erebus Motorsport , Cooper Murray started third and that is where he finished, after a drive that was unobtrusive because it lacked anything that looked like an error. “I am very emotional at the moment,” he grinned after the first top-three result of his career. “Second round with this team and we are on the podium. On to bigger and bigger things. “I always knew I had the belief in my own ability. Thank you to everyone at PremiAir Racing for giving me the opportunity. I got off the [start] and it was a steady race from there, probably one of the easiest races I have had in the Main Game.” Broc Feeney took fourth in his Triple Eight Ford, thereby ensuring that he is one of the four Finalists, on what was a tricky weekend for the team. Will Brown started the weekend in Finals contention but his hopes were doomed before the race started. He failed to advance from the first phase of Qualifying by 0.04s and started the race from 19th, from where only freakish circumstances would have placed him in contention to win. No such events came; by the flag he was an impressive sixth, just 12 seconds behind teammate Feeney, but it was win-or-bust for the former champion. Photo by:

technology.title: Internet governance about to get its quadrennial stress test at ITU meeting
technology.description: The International Telecommunications Union (ITU) kicks off its quadrennial plenipotentiary on Monday, and internet governance organizations are bracing in case the event becomes a forum for nation-states to try to challenge their roles. The ITU is the United Nations' specialized agency for information and communication technologies, meaning its members are nation-states. The body's role is to facilitate international connectivity, which it does by managing radio spectrum, satellite orbits, and working on relevant technical standards. Its key standards are pervasive. ITU-T X.509 sets out the rules of public key infrastructure. ITU-T E.164 governs telephone numbers. ITU-T H.264 and 265 define the video codecs used for most online streams. The ITU's role is largely uncontested, yet its work gets very close to that of the organizations who work on technologies that make the internet work. Those bodies include the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF); the Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN), which oversees the domain name system; and the regional internet registries (RIRs), which manage IP addresses. The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) works on HTML, CSS, and accessibility. Governments participate in work at those internet governance bodies but are just one voice among many and can't override the consensus-driven decision-making process they use, under a system which has come to be known as the multi-stakeholder governance model. At a 2025 event called WSIS+20, the United Nations endorsed multi-stakeholder governance by deciding that its Internet Governance Forum (IGF) should become a permanent body. That decision effectively endorsed multi-stakeholder governance, and kept the ITU out of internet standards. Yet the IGF hasn't met since WSIS+20, so it is yet to start operating meaningfully as a permanent body. This year's ITU meeting is therefore a moment at which stakeholders can stress-test the delicate balance between the ITU, internet governance bodies, and the emerging IGF. Such a test could see ITU members try to have it pursue new fields that overlap with work performed by internet governance organizations. This has already happened before. China tried to have the ITU work on " New IP" – a major revision to internet protocol, a technology the IETF manages. In 2022, Russia and China backed a candidate for the ITU presidency who favored giving nations a stronger role in internet governance, potentialy by having the ITU take over some standards work. That candidate was not elected. Ahead of next week's meetings, the Internet Society published a background paper that declared it is "actively challenging proposals that could affect the Internet's underlying technical architecture or increase fragmentation, as well as those that could affect connectivity, particularly for remote, underserved, and unserved communities." science.title: On this day in space! Nov. 7, 1992: NASA launches Mars Global Surveyor, its 1st Mars mission in 20 years at the time, to map the Red Planet like never before
science.description: null On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission. This was the first mission NASA sent to Mars in almost 20 years! The Mars Global Surveyor spacecraft was an orbiter. It transmitted data from NASA's Mars rovers Sojourner , Spirit and Opportunity back to Earth. The spacecraft also did a lot of its own science. It found surface channels on Mars that appeared to have been created by running water. Mars Global Surveyor looked at the south pole of Mars and saw signs of possible climate change. It also saw a mineral called hematite on Mars. Hematite usually forms in water. NASA then sent its Spirit and Opportunity rovers to look for the hematite, and both rovers found it near their landing sites. Mars Global Surveyor survived much longer than expected. But a space maneuver accidentally exposed one of its batteries to the sun, and the spacecraft lost power. It fell silent forever in November 2006 . NASA launches the Mars Global Surveyor to Mars on a Delta II rocket on Nov. 7, 1996. (Image credit: NASA) Why it mattered As the first successful Mars mission since the two Viking launches in 1975, Mars Global Surveyor ushered in a new era of exploration of the Red Planet, not only through its own contributions to orbit-based science, but by serving a relay for surface-based rovers. As such, it became a primary pipeline for multiple concurrent Mars missions. "The [Mars Global Surveyor] mission overhauled scientists' understanding of Mars by studying the entire Martian surface, atmosphere and interior. Major findings included dramatic evidence that water still flows on Mars in short bursts down hillside gullies, and the identification of water-related mineral deposits leading to selection of a Mars rover landing site for a subsequent mission," read a NASA description of the probe. Mars Global Surveyor sent back more than 240,000 images to Earth during its nine active years. Want more space history? science.title: Send your name to Saturn's moon Titan with NASA's upcoming Dragonfly mission
science.description: null We still may be some time away from sending humans to distant reaches of the solar system, but you can send your name to Saturn's moon Titan, which has the ingredients of life on its surface thanks to NASA's Dragonfly mission. Dragonfly is an SUV-sized nuclear-powered rotorcraft that NASA aims to launch towards Titan in 2028. The agency opened a special events page in late October to allow members of the public to put their name on the spacecraft. The names will be put upon a chip on Dragonfly during the spacecraft's assembly, and all names must be submitted before Jan. 15, 2027. The agency says that the mission has no "ordinary itinerary," as Dragonfly aims to between areas miles (or kilometers) apart after arriving on the surface in 2034. "Nearly a billion miles away, an extraordinary destination awaits. Titan has an atmosphere, rivers and lakes, seasons, sweeping dunes and a landscape rich in organic material," NASA officials wrote in the event page. "Upon arrival in 2034, Dragonfly will fly from place to place on this intriguing world to uncover clues about this remarkable moon, and the chemistry that could help us understand the ingredients for life." Dragonfly will be one of just a few flying crafts on another world, with the first being NASA's plucky Ingenuity mini-helicopter that arrived on Mars along with the still-running Perseverance rover in 2021. Ingenuity was only designed to make five flights, but made it to 72 until its blades were damaged during a landing on Jan. 18, 2024. NASA is now planning a SkyFall mission on Mars that would use three helicopters, and which may launch as soon as late 2028 for the Red Planet. Dragonfly, however, is not the first mission to Titan: that would be Huygens , which operated for just a few hours on Jan. 14, 2005 after deploying from the Cassini spacecraft. Huygens was the first lander on an outer solar system world, and measured Titan's atmosphere and took data from the surface. A mosaic image of Saturn's moon Titan composed of images produced by the Cassini spacecraft. (Image credit: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/University of Idaho) For its part, Cassini flew by Titan more than 100 times before the mission concluded in September 2017 , providing valuable long-term data about the moon from above. Dragonfly aims to show the moon from up close for about 3.3 Earth years. Its destinations will include dunes and a young impact crater called Selk, according to NASA. "Dragonfly is expected to make one flight every one to two Titan days, which is called a Tsol and lasts about 16 Earth days," NASA officials added of the mission . Dragonfly will stop at a variety of geologic sites, where it will collect samples of surface material for analysis inside the rotorcraft by a suite of scientific instruments." science.title: Star Wars is experiencing a golden age of video games
science.description: After a tumultuous start to EA's rebooted Star Wars Battlefront series, in 2021 Lucasfilm and Disney decided to open up the development of new Star Wars games by bringing in different publishers and studios under the Lucasfilm Games banner. Now, over five years on, we can confidently say we're entering a new golden era of amazing Star Wars games . With LucasArts' successor calling the shots and coordinating a multitude of projects set in a galaxy far, far away, even EA's latest efforts like Squadrons and the Jedi series have taken bigger and bolder swings. Now, in 2026, the full potential of the Star Wars universe has become clearer with specific releases squarely aimed at niche audiences. It's become clear that future Star Wars games needn't be expensive endeavors full of familiar faces or concepts. Star Wars Zero Company and Galactic Racer 's restrained scope and confidence have been infectious, and, as it turns out, they're already recognized by all the parties involved as double-A success stories . The original Burnout studio, Criterion, would have been an excellent candidate, but instead they were sent to work in the Battlefield mines. Still, someone was interested in the idea, and the end result is glorious. Fast and furious, Star Wars: Galactic Racer ignores recent racing game trends and bets big on arcade-y vibes, uncomplicated controls, and a high skill ceiling that challenges you with extremely high speeds, tight turns, and unexpected interruptions as other drivers try to ruin your day. But the road from Artemis II's success to crewed lunar landings and, later, a permanent moon base will take a lot of launches of NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) megarocket, Isaacman stressed. "It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites for the USSF's Space Based Sensing and Targeting (SBST) portfolio based on SpaceX's Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches," NextSpaceflight.com wrote in a mission description . Starlink is SpaceX's LEO broadband megaconstellation, which consists of more than 11,000 active satellites.
